long.name: Long term
long.plan: Buy on the first trading day of the month, limit at the prior close +1%, about RM6,000 each in 100-share lots, only into empty slots (4 slots). Sell at the next open after a month-end close under the 200-day average; stop 25% under the buy; sell when the dividend is omitted or cut by more than half; if it leaves the Shariah list sell when above cost, else hold to breakeven. In June and December re-rank: keep a holding while it is still in the top 12.
long.zone_rule: Buy zone (suggestion only): from 2% under the lowest close of the last 10 sessions up to the lower of the prior close +1% and 5% above that 10-day low. Above the zone the stock has run away from its recent pullback.

view.name: Day Trade
view.status: RESEARCH, UNPROVEN (earlier tests: no edge for day trading)
view.plan: Limit buy at the close - 0.3 ATR (down to a tick); cancel if not filled by the next close. Stop = entry - 1 ATR (if Moomoo MY has no stop order on Bursa, sell at the next open when the close is below the stop). Target = entry + 1 ATR: a limit sell placed the evening after the fill. Time exit: not hit by the end of day 2, sell at the day-3 open with a low pre-open limit. Size = RM180 / ATR in 100-share lots, at most RM6,000.
view.mock_rules: RM24,000, at most 2 new orders a day and 4 open. The dip-buy limit fills only when the low reaches the limit minus 1 tick; a bar that touches both the stop and the target counts as the stop; a gap through the stop sells at the open; costs per side: brokerage 0.03%, platform RM3, clearing 0.03%, stamp 0.1%, 1 tick slippage.

checks.rare_text: RARE SETUP - not a pick. A very volatile cheap stock (under RM0.50) at a new 252-day high after a 6% fall within the last 5 days, with a 6-month gain of 39% or more. In the past 8% of such cases rose 300% within a year (normal 0.6%) and 1.5% rose 900% within two years (normal 0.1%). But most lost money: after costs the average trade was -5%, and no exit rule, including a protective stop at the cost-cover level and no profit cap, made the average positive. It appears about 16 times a year, mostly in market crashes and rebounds (2020). Default action: stay in the money-market fund.
